selection_rules: Only Codex, Grok CLI, Claude Code and OpenCode are active houses. Cursor removed from Interchange routing, not uninstalled.
Grok work uses Grok CLI only, model grok-4.6 with high or xhigh. No Cursor route.
Claude development uses claude-opus-5 medium or high. Sonnet and automatic fallback to it are excluded.

Brain boundary: only assigned Sol high, Astra medium and Fable 5.1 medium brain profiles resolve product, behavior, architecture or tradeoff ambiguity. Fable is for product ideation; Astra is for unusually large cross-workstream ambiguity; Sol high is the default.

Semantic and risk acceptance is a brain task: use an independent Sol high reviewer, or Astra medium for unusually large cross-workstream scope. Mechanical workers may collect gates but cannot issue acceptance judgment.
Coordination is not judgment authority. Opus delivery managers and mechanical leads may coordinate, monitor and integrate, but route unresolved interpretation to an approved brain.

Mechanical packets contain settled behavior, objective acceptance, owned paths, allowed variance and an escalation condition. Workers return evidence and the smallest question when a choice requires interpretation.

Use fast, low-cost mechanical workers when startup, supervision and integration overhead still improves accepted-result time or cost. Parallelize independent objectively testable packets after decisions, interfaces and write ownership are fixed.
Muse Spark 1.3 is the preferred light mechanical and read/seek lane for repository search, file localization, evidence collection, narrow checks and small explicit edits.
Do not fragment work when dispatch, context transfer or integration overhead would erase the expected speed or cost gain.
More reasoning is not universally more intelligence or better value. Terra max handles difficult settled implementation, not unresolved product decisions.
No automatic repeated effort increases. Stop, diagnose or reassign under existing watchdog and recovery limits.
High consequence can require stronger review even for a small edit. Model choice never removes acceptance gates.
Verify effective model and effort at dispatch. Newly configured Grok/Opus combinations are not yet claimed smoke-tested; no unapproved substitution.

House exclusivity has two scopes. Astra at any effort reserves Codex globally and Fable 5.1 at any effort reserves Claude globally. Sol high or higher reserves Codex only for assignments under the same delivery manager; Opus high or higher reserves Claude only for assignments under the same delivery manager.
New-product brainstorming may use Fable 5.1 medium or Astra medium. Both create global house reservations while active; prefer another eligible house or queue competing work.
Fable model authorization does not permit paid usage credits or extra spending. Verify included allowance before any headless request.
The delivery manager keeps its turn active with a real bounded wait while workers run. It may finish only after terminal handbacks or explicit transfer to another live supervisor.
External provider streams are drained outside manager context. Retrieve compact lifecycle changes and the mechanically extracted final assistant result, not accumulated raw output.
A provider parent exit does not transfer writer ownership. Verify process tree, worktree command/CWD holders and provider background-agent registry before any replacement writer.
Stop Claude after two consecutive no-progress auto-compactions; checkpoint and use one fresh narrow retry rather than resuming the thrashing session.
Owner concurrency exceptions are finite and journalled after an occupancy probe; leads and managers cannot self-authorize them.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash uses the provider code opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash. The human-readable name and provider code identify the same approved model. The provider renamed this code from opencode-go/deepseek-flash, which no longer appears in `opencode models`; the version now lives in the code itself.

DeepSeek high is the default for bounded implementation. DeepSeek max mechanically implements novel public contract, identity, schema or serialization shapes only after an approved brain settles the shape and objective contract tests.

DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash and the vision-exp variants are excluded: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro, opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash and opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are DIFFERENT models, not fallbacks for V4.1 Flash. If opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash is unavailable, stop and reroute to a different approved house; never substitute another DeepSeek model.

house_exclusivity.global_scope: All visible Interchange-managed active assignments in the same house across delivery managers, deliveries, projects and roles
house_exclusivity.delivery_manager_scope: All active assignments owned or supervised by the same delivery manager, across that manager's deliveries, projects and roles
house_exclusivity.rule: A global trigger prevents every other visible Interchange-managed assignment from overlapping in that house. A delivery-manager trigger prevents same-house overlap only among assignments owned or supervised by that delivery manager; separately managed deliveries may still use the house. Check new and existing assignments symmetrically. Higher levels apply only where model/tool supported and separately approved.
house_exclusivity.conflict_action: Prefer an eligible other house; otherwise queue. Do not silently lower effort, kill other sessions, or widen permissions.
house_exclusivity.release: Release only after attempt stops or is explicitly suspended with no remaining computation and supervisor ownership preserved; an open idle transcript alone is not an active assignment.
house_exclusivity.manager_effect: An active Astra manager reserves Codex globally. An active Sol-high manager reserves Codex within its own managed work. An active Opus-high manager reserves Claude within its own managed work. No implicit exemption for same-scope subagents or review.
house_exclusivity.outside_activity: Check visible external activity without controlling it; user sessions outside Interchange cannot be reliably locked by skill text. Disclose unknown occupancy.
house_exclusivity.status: Instruction policy only; cross-process reservation enforcement awaits live runner

cognitive_roles.rule: Only assigned profiles in the decision-brain lists may resolve product, behavior, architecture or tradeoff ambiguity. A brain-capable model running under a worker profile remains a mechanical leaf.
cognitive_roles.mechanical_boundary: Every other profile receives settled behavior, objective acceptance, owned paths and an explicit escalation condition. If more than one valid choice requires judgment, return evidence and the smallest question to a brain.
cognitive_roles.coordination_boundary: A delivery manager or lead without an assigned brain profile may coordinate, monitor and integrate but must route unresolved interpretation to a brain.
cognitive_roles.semantic_acceptance_rule: Only profiles in semantic_review_brain may issue semantic or risk acceptance. Product-ideation brains, coordinators and mechanical workers cannot.
